nodes.description: Microscopic photosynthetic plankton. Functional group of diatoms and flagellates pooled by the source study because they were measured together in net samples.
Small drifting animals grazing on phytoplankton. Functional group of copepods and larval crustaceans pooled by the source study because gut-content data were aggregated at this level.
